study_id.description: Slug of the study owning this arm.

run_id.description: The active session run ID (maps 1:1 to the current study round; scopes run artifacts).

arm.description: Stable identifier of the arm to execute.

kind.description: Bottleneck kind from study.BOTTLENECK_KINDS (see study-round.json) deciding execution strategy and specialist delegation.

claim.description: Describe the optimization that should improve the metric.

target_parameters.description: Optional parameters or tuning knobs for the arm hypothesis.

bundle_dir.description: Optional path to a distributed serving (llm-d) Kustomize bundle directory.

namespace.description: Optional target Kubernetes namespace for distributed serving deployment and benchmarking.

kubeconfig.description: Optional kubeconfig path for target GKE cluster access.

context.description: Optional Kubernetes context name for target GKE cluster access.

service_url.description: Optional explicit serving endpoint URL for distributed serving benchmarks.

examples.claim: Fused MoE SwiGLU kernel eliminates HBM traffic on intermediate activations.
